name: Power Pole
summary: Demo V8 lets you shut down the entire electricity network with E on a power pole. Check for an accidental shutdown when several machines stop together.
version: Demo V8 announcement (September 11, 2026); follow your installed build’s prompts

data.check: Read the power network notification: V8 added a visual warning when power falls below the required threshold. Check the network state and connected machines before expanding production.
data.limits: Use the current game’s displayed demand and generation. The announcement does not provide per-machine wattage, a universal wire range or a complete generator budget.
